Passover/Lords Supper continuity and fulfillment, spiritual feeding, self-examination and admission.

Prayer, church under trial and assurance of final victory.
Amos: covenant privilege carries accountability, call and required response.

Several I Belong pages contain missing-figure placeholders; do not copy them into course as finished graphics.
Candlestand is a later declaration about charismatic movement, not one of Three Forms of Unity.
Articles and sermons have subordinate explanatory authority and require scriptural/confessional evaluation.

official_sources.title: The Belgic Confession - Canadian Reformed Churches
Canons of Dort - Canadian Reformed Churches

three_forms_comparison.shared: All three are subordinate doctrinal standards answering to Scripture, united in the Triune God, human sin, salvation by grace in Christ through faith, church/sacraments and grateful holiness. They complement rather than replace the ecumenical creeds.

documents.title: Belgic Confession
documents.date: 1561; later ecclesiastical reception and revision must be distinguished from first composition.
documents.place: Southern Netherlands, under Habsburg rule; do not project modern Belgium borders backwards.
documents.genre: 37-article church confession; comprehensive doctrinal witness and public defense under persecution.
documents.author: Chiefly Guido de Bres; avoid portraying entire church as jointly drafting every sentence.
documents.problem: Show persecuted Reformed believers profess biblical Christianity and are not inherently political rebels.
documents.architecture: God and revelation, Trinity and creation, fall and salvation, church and sacraments, civil government, final judgment.

documents.title: Heidelberg Catechism
documents.place: Heidelberg, Electoral Palatinate within the Holy Roman Empire.
documents.genre: 129 personal catechetical questions in 52 Lords Days; pastoral formation and public instruction.
documents.author: Commissioned by Elector Frederick III; Ursinus central with wider theological cooperation; traditional Olevianus attribution requires nuance.
documents.problem: Instruct youth and give pastors/teachers a common doctrinal teaching guide amid confessional disputes.
documents.architecture: Comfort; misery, deliverance, gratitude; Apostles Creed, sacraments, Decalogue and Lords Prayer.

documents.title: Canons of Dort
documents.place: Dordrecht, Dutch Republic; synod with foreign Reformed delegates.
documents.genre: Targeted doctrinal judgments against Remonstrant objections, positive exposition and rejection of errors.
documents.problem: Clarify election, atonement, depravity/conversion and perseverance in specific controversy.
documents.architecture: Five heads in four chapters because III/IV are combined; not a comprehensive catechism and not merely the later TULIP acronym.
documents.edition_note: CCI edition has 59 positive articles plus four rejection groups; lacks separately printed Conclusion. This is source scope, not license to invent an equivalent translation.

three_forms_comparison.why_three: Different pastoral and historical tasks require a broad public confession, a teaching catechism, and focused doctrinal judgments. Their authority rests on conformity to Scripture, not on adding three independent revelations.

topic_crosswalk.interpretation: Scripture norms confession; gospel preaching is the appointed means.
Christ is saving ground, faith receives him, good works are fruit not purchase price.
Do not require speculative access to the secret decree before trusting gospel promises.
Distinguish covenant administration, sacramental sign, saving union and election; baptism is not automatic regeneration.
Sovereign grace works through Word, sacraments, discipline and prayer, not independently of them.

covenant_cautions: The Three Forms do not use the same detailed covenant taxonomy as Westminster 7; label later covenant-of-works/grace formulations as systematic explanation.
Do not collapse all historical covenant members into the eternally elect, nor imply baptism guarantees final salvation.
Do not equate faith as necessary receiving instrument or covenant obligation with meritorious cause.

PRCA distinctive rejection of common grace or gracious gospel offer must not be attributed to every Continental Reformed federation. Its official homepage identifies its covenant emphasis as unconditional.
Historical geography clarifies setting; it does not prove theological truth.
